newsitem.title: UK: BFI up six at 1,440, firmer conditions seen.
newsitem.headline: BFI up six at 1,440, firmer conditions seen.

text.p: The spot Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose six points to 1,440 with generally firmer conditions seen for most types of tonnage worldwide, brokers said.
They said Cargill are reported to have fixed a Panamax for heavy grain US Gulf/Hamburg for mid-December at $13.00.
Brokers believe that US Gulf/Japan rates are also edging forwards - $23.50 or more is now reckoned to be the minimum rate for no combo fixtures for December.
The Plate is firm for all categories of tonnage and Capers are especially active in the Far East, they added.
